topic: Broom and brush bristle colors: yellow, green, blue, pink, Gold Series, and custom
caption:
Color is more than looks. The right color can make your product easier to recognize on the shelf. 🌈

At Indofilament, our broom and brush bristles come in yellow, green, blue, and pink. There is also the Gold Series with Bright Gold and Copper Gold options in a pearl finish. For red, purple, orange, black, white, or custom colors, talk to us about your needs. Diameter, length, and stiffness can also be adjusted.

The main material is nylon made from recycled plastic raw materials, so it stays eco-friendly.

Want to see the colors in person? Request a sample via WhatsApp +62 831-6591-3330 or DM us. ✨ Our factory in Tangerang is also open for visits.
